test_unknown_fields_serialization: test that unknown fields are preserved when serializing a protobuf message with unrecognized fields
test_discard_unknown_fields: test the DiscardUnknownFields method to remove all unknown fields from a protobuf message
test_unknown_fields_merge: test merging two protobuf messages where unknown fields are correctly combined from source to destination
test_unknown_enum_values: test that unknown enum values are preserved as unknown fields when parsing protobuf messages
test_unknown_fields_clear: test that calling Clear on a protobuf message also clears all stored unknown fields
